[2026-09-01T01:40:48.697Z] [world] The flat silt heaves, and a hand breaks the surface, then an arm, then a face caked grey with a thousand years of it.
[2026-09-01T01:40:48.697Z] [arbiter] This is one of the Aetherkin, then — not a story after all. The dead of old Tartaria, still walking because the Aether in them never stopped.
[2026-09-01T01:40:48.698Z] [world] In life it was a baker, flour still ghosts the creases of what were once their sleeves — you find yourself wanting to know their name, and knowing you never will. The ground gave them back without warning — one moment mud, the next a person who should be dead.
[2026-09-01T01:40:48.698Z] [world] It doesn't lunge. It cringes back, arms up over its face — remembering, dimly, that living things once meant harm. It will only fight if you make it.
